name: nn-skills-marketplace
description: API reference skills for Nikolai Nobadi's public Swift packages. Each skill lives in the package repo it documents, so the API and its docs change together.

plugins.name: SwiftPickerKit
plugins.description: SwiftPickerKit Swift API reference for terminal-based interactive pickers

plugins.name: NnReminderKit
plugins.description: NnReminderKit Swift API reference for local notification scheduling and management on Apple platforms.

plugins.name: NnSwiftUIKit
plugins.description: NnSwiftUIKit Swift API reference — reusable SwiftUI components, error handling, font system, and view modifiers for iOS/macOS/watchOS.

plugins.name: NnVersionKit
plugins.description: NnVersionKit Swift API reference for app version checking and update prompts. USE WHEN checking app version, forced update UI, checkingAppVersion view modifier, VersionUpdatePolicy, forcing updates by version range, update available status, VersionUpdateStatus, onStatus callback, UI test version seeding, StaticVersionLoader, VersionLoader, AppStoreVersionLoader, DeviceBundleVersionLoader, VersionNumber comparison, App Store version lookup, VersionKitError.

plugins.name: ConsoleProgressKit
plugins.description: ConsoleProgressKit Swift API reference for showing progress in command-line tools — live spinners, progress bars, and plain log lines on stderr. USE WHEN using ConsoleProgressKit, ProgressDisplay, LiveProgressDisplay, PlainProgressDisplay, ActivityHandle, track(_:operation:), NoteStyle, ProgressTheme, TerminalColor, TerminalCapabilities, TerminalStream, TextStyle, TextStyler, AnsiTextStyler, PlainTextStyler, ConsoleProgressTesting, MockProgressDisplay, TaggingTextStyler, OR adding spinners, progress bars, or progress output to a Swift CLI, OR choosing their colors, OR styling a Swift CLI's final output, OR honoring NO_COLOR.

plugins.name: nn-cli-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture reference for Swift command-line tools built on NnArgumentParser: root command and factory, the NnWorkflow inspect/collect/resolve pipeline, folder layout, file style, and workflows for a new CLI, for adding a command, for reviewing an existing tool, and for catching a tool up after architecture changes.

plugins.name: MCPServerKit
plugins.description: MCPServerKit Swift API reference and capability generator for building MCP servers. USE WHEN using MCPServerKit, LocalMCPServer, MCP server implementations, MCP tools, MCP resources, MCP prompts, reviewing existing MCP server code, OR adding new MCP tools, read capabilities, write capabilities, resource-backed capabilities to a Swift MCP server.

plugins.name: nn-architecture
plugins.description: Universal architecture principles shared by the nn architecture skills: how types are classified and named, independent of any kind of project.

plugins.name: nn-mcp-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture reference for Swift MCP servers built on MCPServerKit: the entry point and startup rules, the feature and capability layout, the protocol and backend behind each tool handler, tool error translation, per-tool annotations, and workflows for creating a server and adding capabilities.

plugins.name: NnCredentialKit
plugins.description: NnCredentialKit Swift API reference for iOS authentication workflows with Firebase integration

plugins.name: NnGoogleAdsKit
plugins.description: NnGoogleAdsKit Swift API reference for Google App Open Ads integration in SwiftUI.

plugins.name: NnGitKit
plugins.description: NnGitKit Swift API reference for typed git and gh commands, GitClient and GitHubClient, consumer-supplied command runners, and MockGitCommandRunner / RecordingGitCommandRunner testing utilities.

plugins.name: NnTestKit
plugins.description: NnTestKit testing plugin — NnTestKit API reference and NnTestKit leak-tracking conventions.

plugins.name: nn-shell-kit
plugins.description: NnShellKit Swift API reference for shell command execution from Swift with protocol-based design, timeout support, and MockShell testing utilities.

plugins.name: nn-file-kit
plugins.description: NnFileKit Swift API reference for file system access from Swift — protocol-based FileSystem/Directory design with a FileManager-backed DefaultFileSystem and MockFileSystem/MockDirectory testing utilities.
